payload.title: Evaluation harness: 10 tasks and a probe, adapter, runner, validators, owner-use count, genesis spec

intent.goal: Evaluation harness: 10 tasks and a probe, adapter, runner, validators, owner-use count, genesis spec
intent.context: Spec: docs/designs/heron-v1.md, section 'Detailed Implementation Plan', Work unit U0 (items 1-9), plus every spec section those items link to. Read the Preconditions and Work units table too. EVE's CLI is on PATH as `eve` (version 0.5.3); `eve chat --help` lists its flags.
intent.constraints: The approved spec is docs/designs/heron-v1.md; its Non-Goals and the owner's decisions in Open Questions are final. Stay inside your blast radius. No edits to Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock and no new crates; Python is standard library only and runs as python3 -I. Toolchain is pinned by rust-toolchain.toml. You have no git: skein commits your worktree when the check passes. Never weaken, skip or delete a test to pass; never fake measurement output. If the spec is wrong or impossible, stop and say exactly why instead of diverging.
intent.completion: python3 -I eval/check_tasks.py eval/core-tasks.md && python3 -I -m unittest discover -s eval/tests -t eval && bash eval/run-core-tasks.sh --provider demo --driver direct --build debug --runs 1 --out "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/u0" && python3 -I eval/check_gate.py --schema-only "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/u0/summary.json"
